341-4399-4770-8319.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Umori.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Greenhouse Propagator trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greenhouse Propagator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
341-4399-4770-8319.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

586-864-3125-7422-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-7422-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

1170-3836-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3836-5131-5330--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Urza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4399-4770-6626-6752.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6626-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

792-1263-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5641-6258-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-3986-5434.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
3259-3986-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, Battle Cry Goblin and other creatures as needed as attackers.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

618-7619.description:
Activate the mutated Necropanther and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

64-2104-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Warden of the Eye and exiling Ephemerate.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5921-5970-7014-7296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

997-1765-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3175-3605-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

57-283-4846-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-6965.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6283-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-6283-6823.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Aunt May indestructible.
3490-4050-6283-6823.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2086-2919-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1491-2228-2757-6667.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Loporrit Scout, untapping a basic land.
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Loporrit Scout ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.

907-1479-5702.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Springheart Nantuko, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1461-3188-4050-4078.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-3188-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Social Climber triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2-4094-5637.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2-4094-5637.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2055-2175-3390-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to The Face of Boe.
The Face of Boe does not have summoning sickness.
2055-2175-3390-4222.description:
Activate The Face of Boe by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast Lotus Bloom from your hand.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {1}{W}, returning Lotus Bloom to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping The Face of Boe.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Memory Crystal

661-1387-2633-2871.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.

1048-3168-4050-5121.notablePrerequisites:
"Myr" chosen with Urza's Incubator.
You have a Myr card in hand with mana value two or less that can be cast for {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
You control a nontoken Myr with mana value two or less that can be cast for {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
1048-3168-4050-5121.description:
Cast the Myr with mana value two or less in your hand by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
Urtet and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Urtet trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Myr token, adding {1}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return the Myr with mana value two or less currently on the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

866-3448-4050-4359.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least three times this game.
866-3448-4050-4359.description:
Cast Stadium Vendors for its blitz cost by paying {R}.
Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, causing you to add {B}{R}.
Cast Garna for its blitz cost by paying {B}{R}.
Garna enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Garna and Stadium Vendors, adding {1}{R}.
Garna and Stadium Vendors die, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 4, returning all creature cards that were put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

500-2047-2557-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-2047-2557-4772.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

1367-2526-3247-5091.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two cards in hand.
You control at least two Zombies.
1367-2526-3247-5091.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Venser's Journal and Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Venser's Journal trigger, causing you to gain at least two life.
Resolve the Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Razaketh by paying 2 life and sacrificing a Zombie token, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

3056-4968.notablePrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3056-4968.description:
Remve a +1/+1 counter from Deathbringer Thoctar, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
That creature triggers, causing its controller to sacrifice it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.
